newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - January 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Daily Variety - January 21.

text.p: The following stories appeared in Tuesday's edition of Daily Variety:
* Sony Corp's Sony Pictures Classics co-presidents Michael Barker, Tom Bernard and Marcie Bloom have bought territory rights to the latest documentary from Errol Morris for a six-figure sum.
* Actress Jodie Foster's voice will be in an upcoming episode of "The X-Files" from News Corp Ltd's Fox Inc during February sweeps.
* Brandon Tartikoff undergoes a second chemotherapy session this week for Hodgkin's disease.

* Westinghouse Electric Corp's CBS in-house distribution company Eyemark Entertainment is pitching the reruns of "Touched by an Angel" to cable networks with "Dave's World." The Family Channel, Time Warner Inc's TBS and Lifetime, which is jointly owned by the Walt Disney Co and Hearst Coro, are interested, sources said. Cable sources say Eyemark is talking about a price of $500,000 per episode for Angel and $450,000 for Dave's World.
